cross_case_limits: All16 proposal arrays are empty. The real-model leg does not establish replacement-proposal generation, application or repair of an already incorrect tracked objective. Proposal ownership is tested only by constructed contract cases.
Inputs already contain well-formed tracked objectives/criteria. This is narrower than extracting a durable ontology from messy real-session histories.
Heldout means separately authored content within the same eight design-mechanism families, not an unseen-task-distribution/generalization benchmark.

No native source authentication, actual Pi hotkey/command, real worker feedback delivery, safe pending-crash recovery, canonical ontology evolution or Human understanding/control improvement was demonstrated.
conclusion: Narrow advisory core is technically feasible. Do not grant automatic governing-intent edits or infer semantic correctness from schema/label checks. Clarify warrant-versus-truth labels and separate primary/ancillary criteria before broader integration.
